• The growth reflects real-world developer adoption, not just benchmark performance.

Grok 4.5 is rapidly emerging as one of the leading AI coding models for serious software engineering.

NEWS: Telstra says Starlink could help save lives in Australia's remote regions. 🇦🇺

• Telstra CEO Vicki Brady says Starlink can help people stranded outside mobile coverage contact emergency services.
• Telstra has partnered with SpaceX to bring Starlink Direct-to-Cell satellite messaging to Australia.
• Eligible customers can send satellite text messages to friends or family when no terrestrial mobile signal is available.
• The service is designed to provide a critical communication option in remote and isolated areas.

Starlink Direct-to-Cell is bringing emergency connectivity to places where traditional mobile networks can't reach.
